# Xolqy

> Xolqy (xolqy.com) is an independent agency that moves small and medium businesses into the agentic AI era, from backend to frontend: AI agents and automation for marketing, sales and internal operations, fast websites, and Cloudflare-first infrastructure. Xolqy started in 2026 as a startup for cookieless web analytics, then quickly grew into something much bigger. Xolqy works with businesses worldwide, with a focus on the US, the UK and Europe.

## What Xolqy is

- An agency that helps businesses, especially small and medium ones, adopt the agentic ecosystem: AI agents that do real work in marketing, sales and operations, connected to the company's own data.
- A builder of fast websites and web applications. Web design and development starts at $1,200, hosting is included, and on delivery the agreed pages score 100 for performance in Lighthouse (PageSpeed Insights) or Xolqy fixes them at no cost.
- An implementer of Cloudflare's platform for its clients: "Cloudflare OS Implementation by Xolqy" (audit, architecture, build and migration in the client's own account).
- Cloudflare-first, not Cloudflare-only: Cloudflare is the preferred platform, chosen per project.

## What Xolqy is not

- Not a web analytics company or analytics vendor. Cookieless analytics is where Xolqy began, and analytics is now one capability among many. The cookieless analytics articles on /blog/ come from that first chapter.
- Not Cloudflare, Inc. Xolqy is independent and is not affiliated with, endorsed by or certified by Cloudflare. Cloudflare and Cloudflare OS are Cloudflare's products, not Xolqy's. Cloudflare is a trademark of Cloudflare, Inc.
- Xolqy does not claim Cloudflare partner status, certifications or awards.

## Offers (as listed on the site)

- [Free health check](https://xolqy.com/health-check/): enter a domain, get a score for HTTPS, security headers, DNS and email setup in seconds.
- [Counselling session, €600](https://xolqy.com/shop/#os-introduction): one session and a written recommendation.
- [Cloudflare OS Implementation by Xolqy](https://xolqy.com/cloudflare-os/): $2,500 pre-Black Friday (regular $5,000).
- [Web design and development](https://xolqy.com/web-design/): from $1,200, hosting included, 100 PageSpeed performance guarantee. Current offers are on the [shop](https://xolqy.com/shop/).
